description:
### Context

The code is part of a project aimed at detecting diseases and pests in rice farms using rice leaf images trained using CNN. The model build of this project was embedded in hardware with TF Lite - Arduino Uno(upgraded to raspberry pi 4). 

###**Device Prototype - Nigerian Rice and Insect Disease Monitor(NIRID) Monitor**
